# Lessons the practice template's learning app (npm run learn) quotes, one per
# line: the lesson id, then the page. The lesson file is learn/lessons/<id>.md
# in the template. The lesson-quotes rule compares the two.

b-2 docs/beginner/02-permission-modes-and-plan-mode.md
b-3 docs/beginner/03-first-change.md
b-4 docs/beginner/04-keep-a-session-on-track.md
b-5 docs/beginner/05-project-memory.md
b-capstone docs/beginner/capstone.md

# Level indexes a warm-up may quote, in the same form: the id <level>-index,
# then the page. A warm-up whose from line names one quotes that page; an
# index has no lesson file of its own.
beginner-index docs/beginner/README.md
intermediate-index docs/intermediate/README.md
advanced-index docs/advanced/README.md
